notes.curl_range.c: Pure range-string parser; all curlx_str_* failures handled, no allocation/fd/OOB. Clean.
notes.warnless.c: Integer narrowing helpers guarded by masks + DEBUGASSERTs; no memory/fd. Clean.
notes.dllmain.c: Windows DllMain stub (OPENSSL_thread_stop on thread detach). No allocation/leak. Clean.
notes.fileinfo.c: alloc via curlx_calloc (caller checks NULL); cleanup is NULL-guarded, frees dynbuf + struct. Clean.
notes.macos.c: SCDynamicStoreCopyProxies result NULL-checked before CFRelease. Clean.
notes.easy_lock.h: Spinlock/SRWLOCK/pthread wrappers; atomic ops only, no allocation. Clean.
notes.sigpipe.h: SIGPIPE save/restore via sigaction; correct paired ignore/restore discipline, no resource. Clean.
notes.header_scan: Only easy_lock.h and sigpipe.h among lib/src headers contain inline function bodies (grep for static inline/CURL_INLINE); all other zero-finding .h files are pure declarations/macros.
